description: Recreate the PayProbe development environment from scratch and recognize the known environment traps. Load this skill when: setting up a fresh clone or fresh machine/VM/sandbox; pip install or editable-install errors (payprobe-worker / payprobe-common "No matching distribution found"); ModuleNotFoundError or ImportError during pytest — i.e. INSTALLING or fixing a missing dependency ("tests fail locally but pass in CI" with crypto/EMV/pycryptodome/aiohttp symptoms; for triaging an UNKNOWN failure use payprobe-debugging-playbook instead); pytest collects zero tests or the wrong tests; npm ci / ng build / Prettier / Playwright problems in the Angular portal; corrupt node_modules; bringing the stack up with docker compose for the first time. Keywords: setup, install, venv, editable install, pip, pytest.ini, make install, make test, npm ci, e2e:install, docker compose, mock mode, Python 3.11, Node 20, pycryptodome, aiohttp.
